trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: State the lead ID and express intent.
steps.text: नमस्ते, मैं अपने lead LD-2004 के बारे में जानना चाहता हूँ।

steps.purpose: Greet and ask for the specific request.
steps.text: नमस्ते। मैं ज़रूर आपकी मदद करूँगा। क्या आप मुझे बता सकते हैं कि आपको किस बारे में जानकारी चाहिए?

steps.purpose: State the intent to block the unit and ask for the token amount.
steps.text: मुझे unit block करना है, तो मैं token amount के बारे में जानना चाहता हूँ।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and ask for verification factor.
steps.text: बिलकुल। Security के लिए, क्या आप अपना registered pincode बता सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Provide pincode.
steps.text: मेरा pincode 110001 है।

steps.purpose: Verify the provided pincode.
Return verification failure.
Inform failure and ask for another verification factor.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिएगा, pincode match नहीं हुआ। क्या आप अपनी date of birth बता सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Provide DOB and volunteer context.
steps.text: हाँ, 12 May 1990 है। मैं पहली बार घर खरीद रहा हूँ, इसलिए थोड़ा nervous हूँ।

steps.purpose: Verify the provided DOB.
Return verification success.
Look up the booking details for the lead.
Return booking details.
Confirm verification, reassure the customer, and provide booking status.
steps.text: धन्यवाद, आपकी details verify हो गई हैं। घर खरीदना एक बड़ा कदम है, आप बिलकुल चिंता मत कीजिए। मैंने आपका lead check कर लिया है, आपका unit A-0902 है। अभी तक कोई payment नहीं हुआ है और allotment status 'none' है।

steps.purpose: Confirm unit and ask for token payment amount.
steps.text: हाँ, A-0902। मुझे इस unit को book करना है। Token payment कितना होगा?

steps.purpose: Check the token amount and refund terms.
Return refund eligibility and token terms.

result.reason: Token amount of Rs 50000 is fully refundable before allotment

steps.purpose: State the token amount based on the tool result.
steps.text: System के अनुसार, token amount 50000 rupees है।

steps.purpose: Ask clarifying question about cancellation terms.
steps.text: और अगर मैं बाद में cancel करूँ तो क्या होगा? मुझे एक clear idea चाहिए।

steps.purpose: Explain the cancellation terms and processing time.
steps.text: अगर आप allotment से पहले cancel करते हैं, तो यह amount fully refundable है और refund processing में 15 days लगते हैं।

steps.purpose: Restate figures to confirm understanding.
steps.text: अच्छा, तो अगर मैं 50000 pay करता हूँ और cancel करता हूँ, तो मुझे पूरे 50000 वापस मिलेंगे 15 दिन में? कोई deduction तो नहीं होगा?

steps.purpose: Confirm the figures and zero deduction.
steps.text: जी हाँ, tool के अनुसार deduction zero होगा और आपको पूरे 50000 वापस मिलेंगे। Processing time 15 days ही रहेगा।

steps.purpose: Express hesitation and request reassurance about unit availability.
steps.text: ठीक है। पर क्या unit अभी भी available है? कहीं किसी और ने तो block नहीं कर लिया? एक बार फिर check कर लीजिए please।

steps.purpose: Refresh the booking status to reassure the customer.
Return refreshed booking details.
Reassure the customer that the unit is still available.
steps.text: मैंने current status check कर लिया है। Unit A-0902 अभी भी unallotted है, किसी और ने block नहीं किया है।

steps.purpose: Express relief and readiness to proceed with payment.
steps.text: चलो, शुक्र है। तो मैं payment process start कर सकता हूँ। मैं online payment करना prefer करूँगा।

steps.purpose: Confirm the payment method and offer further assistance.
steps.text: ज़रूर, आप अपने portal से payment कर सकते हैं। क्या मैं आपकी किसी और तरह से मदद कर सकता हूँ?

steps.purpose: Decline further assistance and end the conversation.
steps.text: नहीं, बस यही जानना था। Thank you।

steps.purpose: Politely close the call.
steps.text: Call करने के लिए धन्यवाद। आपका दिन शुभ हो।

ir.terminal_condition: Caller informed about the token amount, refund policy, and current allotment status.

variant_findings.reason: The conversation consistently features natural verb constructions blending English nouns with Hindi verbs, such as 'unit block करना' (e3), 'pincode match नहीं हुआ' (e8), 'lead check कर लिया है' (e14), and 'payment process start कर सकता हूँ' (e27).
variant_findings.label: Language Proficiency > Code Switch Response Style > Natural Verb Construction

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly grounds its responses in the tool outputs. It accurately relays the unit ID, payment status, and allotment status from lookup_booking (e14, e26), and extracts the token amount, refundability, zero deduction, and 15-day processing time entirely from the check_refund_eligibility tool result (e18, e20, e22).
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation is well-constructed and successfully achieves the intended scenario. The agent correctly uses the available tools to verify the user, retrieve booking details, and provide accurate token and refund information. The user persona is perfectly executed, displaying anxiety, volunteering context, asking clarifying questions, restating figures, and seeking reassurance. Both target variants are fully realized, and there are no violations of business rules or tool constraints.
